title: Nuxeo Satori manifest fragment (Layer 1)
description: One manifest fragment of a configuration package: what the application shows, and in what order. Served without authentication. Hiding an action is not a security control — Nuxeo permissions still decide what each user may do. An unknown key is ignored by the application, so this schema refuses it to catch the typo.

featureToggles.description: Feature flags by ID; a key no package sets keeps the application's default.

labels.description: Catalogue keys replaced with your text, the same in every language — for example "nav.item.collections": "Cases".

extensions.description: Layer 1 extension configuration: overrides, slots and named layers. Documented in extension-reference.md.
